[P2] Keep UTF-8 encoding inside the exception handler

A parsed JSON string containing an unpaired surrogate survives `json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False)` but raises `UnicodeEncodeError` during UTF-8 encoding. Previously, the existing `ValueError` handler caught this and returned `None`; now the exception reaches `_ExportScheduler`, which skips the entire export, including custom exporters capable of writing ASCII-escaped JSON. Move the encoding back inside the protected block and add a regression test with a bounded capture exporter.
